title: The Perfect Victim: Computational Analysis of Judicial Attitudes towards Victims of Sexual Violence

bias_targets.target: Gender bias (Rape myths and victim credibility bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Extracting sentences regarding victim credibility from Hebrew judicial decisions using a syntactic search tool (SPIKE), and fine-tuning a language model (AlephBERT) to classify judicial attitudes into an empirically-motivated ontology. The classified statements are then analyzed to detect the prevalence of implicit biases and 'rape myths' (e.g., beliefs about false accusations or vengeful motives) in the legal system.

primary_bias_target: Gender bias (Rape myths and victim credibility bias)
